fields.score: Composite 0-100 recomputed by collect_snapshot.py: HN devs 40, HN comments 20, max(stars, downloads) 16, HN title points 12, each log-scaled against the category's best tracked tool, rescaled to 100
fields.hn_devs: HN developers naming the tool in the curated Ask HN AI-setup threads (setup_threads in the config)
fields.hn_comments_12m: HN comments matching the tool's first query, last 12 months
fields.hn_title_points: Sum of points of HN stories with the tool in the title, last 12 months
fields.devto: dev.to posts with the tool's tag, last 12 months (only for tools with a tag)
fields.tags: Rising, Fading, New in 2026, Open source
fields.hn_devs_12m: Same, counting only comments from the last 12 months

notes: Measured with our own queries, not taken from the source. source_query=true marks tools whose HN comment query reproduces the source's count. Top 10 per category is re-ranked by the recomputed score among all tracked tools; `others` holds the rest. Names marked collision=true collide with common words: their counts need reading (samples in the raw file).
